verdict: No confident flood detection. The 18→30 Aug pair falls 8+ days after the 21–22 Aug peak rain, the scene median brightened (+0.2 dB, dry-down), and the flagged fragments sit no closer to mapped waterways than random points. Permanent lakes (34 km²) are correctly masked. Treat this case as a negative result: L-band confirms the flood wave had passed, not a flood map.

water_index_experiment.conclusion: No water-index variant rescues Latvia: HV channel is silent (0 px), ratio degenerates to shipped rule, loosening only adds fragments. Post-peak 18->30 Aug pair; honest negative stands.
